***WEB REPORT*** A SEMI-TRUCK PULLED THROUGH A PARKING LOT AND SNAGGED A LOW HANGING PHONE WIRE. THE PHONE WIRE WAS ATTACHED TO AN AEP UTILITY POLE, WHICH WAS BROKEN. THE PIER SECTIONS ARE STACKED NEXT TO THE FURNACE AND MY PARENTS WITNESSED THEM PUTTING THESE SECTIONS INTO THE FURNACE. ***WEB REPORT*** ON 06MAY2013, BETWEEN THE HOURS OF 0000-0700 (APPROX.), CGC TAMPA ACCIDENTALLY DISCHARGED 31 GALLONS OF UNLEADED GASOLINE FROM A STORAGE DRUM LOCATED ON THE FANTAIL. REASON FOR DISCHARGE WAS A FAULTY VALVE ON THE STORAGE DRUM. THE CLOSEST POINT OF LAND DURING THAT TIME PERIOD WAS BEACH HAVEN, NEW JERSEY, 52 NM WEST. BOTH WIND AND SEA DIRECTION VARIED BETWEEN 054 DEG TO 072 DEG TRUE, IN A DIRECTION AWAY FROM THE CLOSEST POINT OF LAND. SEA STATE WAS 1 FT, WITH SWELLS AT 4 FT. CGC TAMPA'S SPEED OF ADVANCE WAS 6-7 KTS OVER THE SAME TIME PERIOD. NO PERSONNEL WITNESSED THE SPILL. THE LAST PERSON WAS ON THE FANTAIL AT APPROX. 0000 06MAY13 AND THE SPILL WAS DISCOVERED AT 0700 06MAY13. NO SPILL CONTAINMENT EFFORTS WERE UNDERTAKEN, AS NO VISIBLE SHEEN WAS WITNESSED.
